Westbrook Library Renovation Update

The library will close on 3 March for eight weeks while the roof and heating system are replaced. The children's section will move temporarily to the community hall on Elm Street.

Book returns can still be made through the drop box by the main entrance, which will be emptied daily. Late fees are suspended during the closure.

The project is funded by a council grant of 450,000 pounds. When the library reopens it will have a new study room with 24 desks and longer opening hours on Thursdays.

Questions can be sent to the branch manager, Helen Adeyemi.
